description: Runs JavaScript in the open page and returns what it returns, as JSON, then up to 5 lines it logged (console.log, warn, info) and up to 5 console errors. In scope: scene, camera, renderer, find(name), stats(target) (vertices, triangles, bounds, closed, volume, genus per mesh), realNow(), window, and THREE on a page that loads three through an import map. performance.now, Date and timers run on the harness's paused clock (code that awaits a timer or frame steps it until done), so to time code here use realNow() (real milliseconds), and end GPU work before reading it (a 1-pixel gl.readPixels; on WebGPU, await renderer.backend.device.queue.onSubmittedWorkDone()). Use it to inspect the scene, try a change before writing it into the source, measure an imported model, or check procedural geometry with stats after each step; changes vanish on reload. A thrown error names where it threw: a line of this code or of the page's own files. Code that keeps the page busy for 30 s (longer on a busy host) is stopped and the page kept: split long work across calls, or await a 0 ms timer every few hundred iterations.

code.description: The body of an async function; return the value to see.

game.description: The name the game was opened under with the `open` tool, to act on ("main" by default; a subagent uses its own).

save.description: Write what the code returns (an ArrayBuffer, typed array, Blob, canvas or data URL) to this path under cwd, e.g. assets/baked.glb or data/mask.png, and reply with its size instead of the bytes: baked geometry, a painted canvas, measured tables.

name: eval
